Home / About Us

About GETLET

A lettings and property management business designed around clear choices, clear money and a repairs process you can follow.

How we are built

Three things the model rests on

Strong online marketing

Your property is promoted on Rightmove, Zoopla, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok to reach suitable tenants.

One rent-collection and payout system

Rent, invoices and payouts run through PayProp, so there is one record to read.

A pre-vetted contractor network

Repairs are handled by contractors we have checked beforehand.

How we want to work

Our principles

You choose your involvement

Fully Managed or Limited Management: the decision about repair approval is yours.

Plain, honest wording

We explain what is included, what is not and how decisions are made, without small print.

Every cost has a record

Work is entered as an invoice before it is deducted from rent.

Talk to us about your property

Book a rental valuation and see whether GETLET is the right fit.

Referral partners

If you are a mortgage broker, accountant, solicitor or landlord association and would like to talk about working together, get in touch. We are not claiming any existing partnerships or endorsements.

Property management for landlords who want a clear choice of involvement, transparent rent accounting and a repairs process they can follow.
